sentences.text:
Deputy Collector Collectorate, Pathanamthitta, Pin - 689645
 Writ petition (civil) praying inter alia

that in the circumstances
stated in the affidavit filed along with the Wp(C) the High Court be
pleased to stay the acquisition proceedings in connection with the
widening of Kuppakkara-Vattamon Road for Konni Medical Collage, over the
land comprised in Re.Survey No. 74/2-2 , 75/3-2 , 74/2-1, 75/3-1 , 74/2,
75/3 of Iravon Village, Konny Taluk , owned and possessed by the
petitioners pending final disposal of this writ petition.

This petition coming on for orders upon perusing the petition and the affidavit filed in support of WP(C) and upon hearing the arguments of SHRI. AJEESH K.SASI, Advocate for the petitioners and of the GOVERNMENT PLEADER for the respondents, the court passed the following:
 T.R. RAVI, J.

Harikumar V vs District Collector on 7 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/11291818/
1  Dated this the 7th day of January, 2025  ORDER
When these cases are taken up, the counsel for the petitioners submits that possession is being taken even without payment of compensation.
Government Pleader seeks time to get instructions.

There will be an interim direction to the respondents not to take possession of the properties belonging to the petitioners without complying with the statutory requirements under the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act,
2013.
